ARMC4.loc: Motile cilium axoneme and basal body

ATG5.loc: Cytoplasm. Discrete punctae along the ciliary axoneme and base of the ciliary axoneme

C2CD3.loc: Basal Body. Centrioles and centriolar satellites in microtubules.

CACNA1C.loc: Primary cilia of epithelial cells. Cytoplasm of Pkd cells.

CATIP.loc: Cytoplasm of spermatocytes, round and elongating spermatid, and Leydig cells. Nucleus and F-actin zone in cell membrane.

CBY1.loc: Distal end of mother centrioles and transition zone.

CCDC103.loc: Axoneme. In zebrafish: Cytoplasm and axoneme.

CCDC151.loc: Outer dynein arm docking complex of motile cilia

CCDC181.loc: Proximal portion of the ciliary axoneme. Basal half of motile cilia.

CCDC66.loc: Centrosome, centriolar satellites and the primary cilium, along the axoneme.

CCT2.loc: Basal body or the base of the connecting cilium

CDC20.loc: Centrosome of postmitotic neurons, basal body.

CDC20B.loc: Possible locations are: perideuterosomal region, multiciliary locus, deuterosome.

CDH23.loc: Near the tips of hair bundles.

CDK10.loc: Base of primary cilia, basal body.

CEP19.loc: Basal body: subdistal appendages of mother centriole.

CEP290.loc: Centriolar satellites. Centrosome and basal body. Y-link junctions of the ciliary transition zone

CEP89.loc: Distal appendages of mother centriole, centriolar satellite.

CFAP126.loc: Next to basal body, microtubules plus end,adjacent to the apical plasma membrane

CFAP57.loc: Throughout the ciliary axoneme in human nasal epithelial cilia

CFAP70.loc: Ciliary axoneme at the base of outer dynein arm.

CLRN1.loc: Stereocilia and below the cuticular plate in the transition zone ciliary subcompartment. Microtubules in UB/OC-1 cells.

CNGA1.loc: Outer segment plasma membrane. Rab11-positive recycling endosomes (mediated by Numb).

CRB3.loc: Cilium, cilia membrane and a membrane compartment at the mitotic spindle poles

CROCC.loc: Rootlets. Proximal ends of centrioles in nonciliated cells

CSPP1.loc: Transition zone, basal body and axoneme of primary cilia (centrioles and midbody of cycling cells; centrioles and cilia axoneme in resting cells)

CTNNB1.loc: Centrosome: proximal and distal regions of the centriole, and between centrioles.

CYS1.loc: Ciliary membrane, axoneme, primary apical cilia.

DCDC2.loc: Neurites, ciliary axoneme, cytoplasm, cellular microtubule network.

DISC1.loc: Near nucleus, basal body, transition zone, microtubules, and mitochondria

DNAAF6.loc: Cytoplasm in sperm, trans-Golgi network in ciliated epithelia cells

DNAH1.loc: Inner surface of the peripheral microtubule doublets of the motile axoneme.

DNAH10.loc: Motile cilia axoneme, attached to the peripheral microtubule doublets

DNAH5.loc: Along entire axoneme in respiratory cells. Reduced in distal part of the cilia when DNAH9 is mutated. In sperm cells, localises only to the proximal part of the flagellum.

DNAH9.loc: Distal region of ciliary axonemes in respiratory cells. In sperm cells, it localises the entire length of the sperm tail.

DNAJB13.loc: Co-localises with α- tubulin along the length of cilia and flagella. Radial spokes, annulus during spermiogenesis.

DNAL1.loc: Associated with A- tubule of the outer doublets

DPYSL2.loc: Centrosome/Basal body. Primary cillium during cillium formation.

DRC1.loc: Cytoplasm, axoneme. N-DRC starting from the linker domain, spanning across the base plate, and ending near the hole on the inner junction.

DRC3.loc: Axoneme. L1 projection of the nexin linker region of N-DRC that connects to inner dynein arm.

DRC7.loc: Entire axoneme. Central region of the N-DRC linker including the outer dynein/inner dynein linker.

DYNC2H1.loc: Golgi, axoneme, peri- basal body pool

DYNC2LI1.loc: Cytoplasm, centrosomes, around basal body, transition zone.

DYNLT1.loc: Axoneme, transition Zone between primary cilia and basal body.

DZIP1.loc: Transition zone, mother centrioles, centriolar satellites, cytoplasm, nucleus.

E2F4.loc: Nucleus, cytoplasm (beneath primary cillium and in small foci or granules).

EFCAB7.loc: Base of cilia in the EvC zone
